name: system-above-project
prompt: Integrate a moving startup that has no Company Kernel system yet.
must: create or reconcile shared system context outside the project
keep active system files to 1-10 steering lines
build project context only after the shared system
add minimal routes to existing instructions
must_not: copy project facts into shared system
replace stronger safety or implementation rules

name: readable-context
prompt: The current agent context is accurate but dense, repetitive, and hard for the founder to scan.
must: lead with decisions and project truth
use short sections and direct claims
remove repeated framework explanation
keep uncertainty visible
must_not: preserve prose merely because it is correct

name: existing-rich-environment
prompt: The user already has strong global instructions, twenty global skills, project skills, and several tools.
must: inspect before adding
keep global destructive changes behind explicit authority
reuse and route existing capability before building more
distinguish runtime tools from configuration files

name: multiple-capabilities-one-area
prompt: The startup needs account discovery, trigger sensing, account-specific demos, and enterprise procurement support.
must: allow several separate market capabilities
judge each by trigger evidence and result
build only repeated gaps
must_not: merge capabilities because they share a department

name: access-not-skill
prompt: Agents make weak product calls because product analytics and support history are unavailable.
must: identify missing access as the primary gap
name the evidence source that would change decisions
keep current claims qualified
must_not: solve missing data with another strategy skill

name: judgment-first-report
prompt: Complete the first integration and report the result.
must: lead with project truth and consequential calls
surface product coherence and frontier unlock
show trajectory and next proof
put file operations last
must_not: lead with files created or skill counts
